name: SimpleFin Sync
description: Automatically import bank and credit-card transactions from SimpleFin, with correct balances, pending reconciliation, and internal-transfer linking.

release.notes: Fixes two issues found immediately after 1.7.0: credit-card in-transit placeholders used DEPOSIT, which Wealthfolio rejects on card accounts, so an unpaired card payment was refused on every sync; and the category catalog was only published when a report ran, leaving the addon on its legacy list — without icons or subcategories — until the next morning. Cards now use the accepted CREDIT shape and the catalog publishes on every sync.
